title: Design System: BioImage 工具平台与 WB 证据工作台

motion.name: panel-reveal
motion.purpose: Only designated control panels; no image, curve evidence or numeric fade.

nativePlatform.exception: Retained Qt Widgets advanced components have no matching Impeccable platform enum. These native snippets are evidence, not HTML previews.
nativePlatform.reduceMotion: QSettings reduce_motion OR not QApplication.isEffectEnabled(Qt.UIEffect.UI_AnimateCombo); immediate stable end state.

nativeComponents.name: Button
nativeComponents.qss:
QPushButton, QToolButton { color: #202523; background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #d9dcd5; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; }

nativeComponents.name: Field
nativeComponents.nativeType: QLineEdit, QSpinBox, QDoubleSpinBox, QComboBox, QTextEdit, QPlainTextEdit

nativeComponents.name: Table
nativeComponents.qss:
QTableWidget { background: #ffffff; color: #202523; gridline-color: #eaebe6;
            selection-background-color: #e3eef0; selection-color: #174f60; border: 0; }

sourceCanvasDrawing.coordinatePolicy: Original-pixel half-open ROI; display raster is never a numerical input.

webPlatform.toolkit: HTML/CSS/JS shared by browser and PySide6 QtWebEngine
webPlatform.entry: python -m bioimage_app --web-workbench; default remains native platform
webPlatform.runtimeBoundary: Browser historical preview and interaction drafts do not recompute; desktop bridge connects real backend. Advanced curves/OCR/templates/normalization remain native.
webPlatform.reduceMotion: prefers-reduced-motion or body.reduce-motion: animation and transition duration 1ms
webPlatform.validationLimit: Static evidence only; backend, dynamic and commit-bound validation belong to T-033.
webPlatform.imageMotion: Image opacity and transform transitions removed; evidence updates without interpolation.
webPlatform.cropInteraction: Four corner handles resize with arrow keys (1 original pixel; Shift 10). Overlay arrows move ROI. Missing ROI supports drawing on the image; minimum 4x4 original pixels to commit. Browser edits remain drafts.

web-body.purpose: 13px body; compact labels have an 11px minimum after the 8/9/10px replacements.

narrative.overview: 图像中心的证据工作台。T-033 网页与 QtWebEngine 加载同一 assets，使用矿物白、深松绿和翡翠操作强调。既有 Qt Widgets 高级窗口保留原生设计记录。浏览器草稿不执行新的科学计算，桌面桥接真实 backend；能力与验收边界以 PRODUCT.md 和 T-033 为准。
keyCharacteristics: 暖白、平面、系统中文字体，图像占据中央主要空间。
图像复核、拼图、结果三种顶层模式；辅助能力通过项目工具和上下文入口到达。
机器建议、人工裁剪审核和质量警告分别表达。
动效只帮助导航定位与控件显现，图像和定量数值保持稳定。

rules.name: The Evidence Canvas Rule
rules.body: 画布配色和显示变换不进入原始像素或定量结果。

rules.name: The Stable Evidence Rule
rules.body: 图像像素、曲线证据和定量数值不做淡入或数值插值。

dos: Do 从实际 Qt palette、QSS 和绘制实现提取角色。
Do 保持原图、来源、曲线、参数和当前结果一致。
Do 用明确文字区分裁剪审核、质量警告、过期和失败。
Do 尊重应用减少动效和 Qt 暴露的系统效果偏好。
donts: Don't 恢复四阶段顶层导航或让高级表格成为默认操作。
Don't 把图像、曲线证据或定量数值加入装饰动画。
Don't 把截图、自动结果或裁剪确认当作科学验收证明。
Don't 把同源 assets 等同于高级能力全部网页化，或虚构全平台偏好检测。
